projects.title: Pi Math First Proof Swarm
evidence: branch experiment/e13; fixed commit to be pinned after branch audit
claims_supported: formal feedback can be integrated into a repeatable swarm experiment
claims_not_supported: a full Putnam sweep establishes general mathematical research ability
projects.next_question: Which feedback and review choices explain the observed differences between attempts?

projects.title: Pi Lean Tools
evidence: branch codex/frontier-probe-command; fixed commit to be pinned after branch audit
claims_supported: Lean-aware local inspection can shorten the feedback loop around a proof attempt
claims_not_supported: local inspection alone solves retrieval, strategy, or long-horizon coordination
projects.next_question: Which local probes are stable enough to become a reusable research contract?

projects.title: Metron
evidence: branch metron/f0-runtime-v2; fixed commit to be pinned after branch audit
claims_supported: unfinished work benefits from explicit distinctions between active routes and valid certificates
claims_not_supported: H/K or any related representation is a universal progress metric
projects.next_question: Can structured unfinished state change continuation decisions on controlled tasks?

projects.title: Persistent Mathematical Worlds
claims_supported: a shared versioned world can be separated from any one agent or session
claims_not_supported: persistent state by itself creates shared cognition or scientific progress
projects.next_question: How can inherited state be tested for causal contribution rather than mere availability?

projects.title: MathWeave
claims_supported: an append-only ledger can remain canonical while maps and retrieval are derived views
claims_not_supported: retrieval or a map automatically constitutes mathematical admission
projects.next_question: Which admission and provenance contracts survive adversarial long-horizon use?

projects.title: PMW Research Platform
claims_supported: cohort and runtime lifecycle can be separated from the persistent mathematical world
claims_not_supported: the current platform is already a live peer-to-peer research plane
projects.next_question: What is the smallest authenticated interface for agents to coordinate a mathematical route?

projects.title: Rights in the Exponent
claims_supported: architectures can assign different force to information under explicit evidence labels
claims_not_supported: the current theory or toy simulations establish a real-model architecture effect
projects.next_question: Which architectural distinctions remain meaningful under controlled executable comparisons?

projects.title: Aperture
claims_supported: replaceability has distinct levels with distinct evidence obligations
claims_not_supported: a bounded Lean construction is a complete replaceable research platform
projects.next_question: Can migration and mid-run switching be tested without promoting evidence across levels?

projects.title: Agent Math Frontier
claims_supported: an evidence ledger can keep formal, executable, informal, and program-level outcomes distinct
claims_not_supported: one aggregate score can faithfully represent every research outcome
projects.next_question: How should independent review and portfolio-level comparison interact?

projects.title: oncewhere
claims_supported: a real experience can be turned into a playable and preservable artifact
claims_not_supported: the creative project is a technical component or validation of the mathematical-agent system
projects.next_question: What forms let a shared experience remain returnable without freezing it into one medium?

projects.title: Trace analysis
evidence: analysis thread; repository link will be added if the apparatus becomes a standalone project
claims_supported: failure traces can change the research question even when they do not yield a positive result
claims_not_supported: trace analysis alone provides a universal causal explanation of swarm outcomes
projects.next_question: Which trace fields are sufficient for an independent diagnosis?
